query:
UPDATE wiki_places
        SET
            name = COALESCE($2, name),
            content = COALESCE($3, content),
            cover_image = COALESCE($4, cover_image),
            category = COALESCE($5, category),
            address = COALESCE($6, address),
            is_audio_muted = COALESCE($7, is_audio_muted),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
